raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Adds an opt-in `torch_nccl` collective implementation for the NCCL checkpoint engine. This allows weight synchronization to use PyTorch `ProcessGroupNCCL` in environments that do not provide a compatible CuPy NCCL binding, while keeping the existing Ray/CuPy implementation as the default.

The default `ray_nccl` path preserves its existing initialization, buffer types, named-group calls, broadcast, barrier, and destruction behavior. The new backend maintains a process-local named-group registry backed by `TCPStore`, `PrefixStore`, and `ProcessGroupNCCL`, so multiple `group_name` values remain isolated and destroying one group does not affect another.

This does not duplicate an existing PR. The open checkpoint-engine PRs found by the searches below address bounded Ray group initialization (#7045) and rank initialization during group reuse (#7870); neither adds a PyTorch NCCL collective backend.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+%28torch_nccl+OR+ProcessGroupNCCL+OR+%22collective+backend%22%29
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

```bash
pytest -q tests/checkpoint_engine/test_nccl_collective.py --tb=short
# 9 passed, 1 skipped

pre-commit run --files pyproject.toml tests/checkpoint_engine/test_nccl_collective.py verl/checkpoint_engine/delta_checkpoint_engine.py verl/checkpoint_engine/nccl_checkpoint_engine.py verl/checkpoint_engine/nccl_collective.py verl/trainer/config/rollout/rollout.yaml --show-diff-on-failure
# all hooks passed
```

A real two-rank `ProcessGroupNCCL` smoke test was also run in an environment without a compatible CuPy NCCL binding. It initialized two named groups, broadcast distinct values through both, destroyed the first group, and successfully reused the second group for another broadcast. A two-step RL run using the checkpoint engine also completed successfully.

The test file includes a two-GPU regression for the unchanged default path. It uses real Ray actors and CuPy tensors for broadcast and barrier, and fails if that path constructs `ProcessGroupNCCL`.

### API and Usage Example

The existing configuration remains unchanged by default. Select the PyTorch implementation explicitly:

```yaml
actor_rollout_ref:
  rollout:
    checkpoint_engine:
      backend: nccl
      engine_kwargs:
        nccl:
          collective_backend: torch_nccl
          collective_backend_kwargs:
            timeout_s: 300
```

`collective_backend_kwargs` is backend-specific. `torch_nccl` accepts `timeout_s`; `ray_nccl` accepts no additional options and rejects accidental configuration.

### Design & Code Changes

- Add a small collective adapter interface around the checkpoint engine operations: initialize, broadcast, barrier, state lookup, and destruction.
- Keep `ray_nccl` as the default adapter and delegate to the same `ray.util.collective` calls with the same arguments.
- Add a named `torch_nccl` adapter using `TCPStore`, `PrefixStore(group_name, store)`, and `ProcessGroupNCCL`.
- Allocate PyTorch buffers only for `torch_nccl`; retain the existing CuPy master buffers for `ray_nccl`.
- Carry the store endpoint in checkpoint topology metadata only when the selected backend requires it.
- Keep `delta_sharded` on `ray_nccl`, since its sparse transfer implementation still operates on CuPy arrays.
- Add unit coverage for backend selection, exact Ray delegation, backend-specific options, named-group isolation, ProcessGroup options, cleanup, and the real default Ray/CuPy path.

AI assistance was used to implement, test, and draft this change. The submitter will review every changed line and confirm the test evidence before moving the PR out of Draft.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting).
- [x] Update the user-facing configuration reference.
- [x] Add unit and real two-GPU regression coverage to the existing checkpoint-engine test suite.
- [ ] Request CI in the `ci-request` channel after the submitter review is complete.
- [ ] Recipe submodule update: not applicable; this PR does not change the recipe submodule.

+    TorchNCCLCollectiveGroup,

+

+    TorchNCCLCollectiveGroup._groups.clear()
+    yield

+
+
+def test_factory_keeps_ray_nccl_as_the_default_implementation():
+    group = create_nccl_collective_group("ray_nccl", "weights")
+
+    assert isinstance(group, RayNCCLCollectiveGroup)
+    assert group.group_name == "weights"
+
+
+def test_checkpoint_engine_keeps_ray_backend_by_default(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr("verl.checkpoint_engine.nccl_checkpoint_engine.cp", MagicMock())

+
+    engine = NCCLCheckpointEngine(
+        bucket_size=1024,
+        collective_backend="torch_nccl",
+        collective_backend_kwargs={"timeout_s": 17},
+    )
+
+    assert isinstance(engine.collective_group, TorchNCCLCollectiveGroup)
+    assert engine.collective_group.timeout == timedelta(seconds=17)
+
+
+def test_collective_backend_kwargs_are_backend_specific():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ray_nccl does not accept"):
+        create_nccl_collective_group("ray_nccl", "weights", {"timeout_s": 17})
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unsupported backend kwargs"):
+        create_nccl_collective_group("torch_nccl", "weights", {"unknown": True})
+
+
+def test_ray_nccl_adapter_preserves_existing_collective_calls(monkeypatch):
+    collective = MagicMock()
+    collective.is_group_initialized.return_value = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(nccl_collective, "ray_collective", collective)
+    group = RayNCCLCollectiveGroup("weights")
+    tensor = MagicMock()
+
+    assert group.initialized
+    group.initialize(world_size=4, rank=2, master_addr="unused", master_port=None)
+    group.broadcast(tensor, src_rank=1)
+    group.barrier()
+    group.destroy()
+
+    collective.init_collective_group.assert_called_once_with(4, 2, "nccl", "weights")
+    collective.broadcast.assert_called_once_with(tensor, src_rank=1, group_name="weights")
+    collective.barrier.assert_called_once_with("weights")
+    collective.destroy_collective_group.assert_called_once_with("weights")
+
+
+def test_default_backend_runs_real_ray_nccl_without_process_group_nccl():
+    """Exercise the unchanged default with real Ray actors and GPU collectives."""

+"""Collective group adapters used by the NCCL checkpoint engines."""
+
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import timedelta
+from threading import Lock
+
+import ray.util.collective as ray_collective
+import torch
+
+from verl.utils.device import get_device_id
+
+
+class NCCLCollectiveGroup(ABC):
+    """Small collective surface required by the checkpoint engines."""
+
+    requires_torch_tensor = False
+
+    def __init__(self, group_name: str):
+        if not group_name:
+            raise ValueError("collective group_name must be non-empty")
+        self.group_name = group_name
+
+    @property
+    @abstractmethod
+    def initialized(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether this process has initialized the group."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def initialize(self, world_size: int, rank: int, master_addr: str, master_port: int | None):
+        """Initialize this rank in the collective group."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def broadcast(self, tensor, src_rank: int = 0):
+        """Broadcast one contiguous tensor."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def barrier(self):
+        """Wait until every rank has initialized the group."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def destroy(self):
+        """Release group resources owned by this process."""
+
+
+class RayNCCLCollectiveGroup(NCCLCollectiveGroup):
+    """Existing Ray/CuPy NCCL implementation."""
+
+    @property
+    def initialized(self) -> bool:
+        return ray_collective.is_group_initialized(self.group_name)
+
+    def initialize(self, world_size: int, rank: int, master_addr: str, master_port: int | None):
+        del master_addr, master_port
+        ray_collective.init_collective_group(world_size, rank, "nccl", self.group_name)
+
+    def broadcast(self, tensor, src_rank: int = 0):
+        ray_collective.broadcast(tensor, src_rank=src_rank, group_name=self.group_name)
+
+    def barrier(self):
+        ray_collective.barrier(self.group_name)
+
+    def destroy(self):
+        if self.initialized:
+            ray_collective.destroy_collective_group(self.group_name)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _TorchNCCLGroupState:
+    store: object
+    process_group: object
+
+
+class TorchNCCLCollectiveGroup(NCCLCollectiveGroup):
+    """Named ProcessGroupNCCL implementation for environments without a compatible CuPy NCCL binding."""
+
+    requires_torch_tensor = True
+    _groups: dict[str, _TorchNCCLGroupState] = {}
+    _groups_lock = Lock()
+
+    def __init__(self, group_name: str, timeout_s: float = 300):
+        super().__init__(group_name)
+        if timeout_s <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"torch_nccl timeout must be positive, got {timeout_s}")
+        self.timeout = timedelta(seconds=timeout_s)
+
+    @property
+    def initialized(self) -> bool:
+        with self._groups_lock:
+            return self.group_name in self._groups
+
+    def _state(self) -> _TorchNCCLGroupState:
+        with self._groups_lock:
+            state = self._groups.get(self.group_name)
+        if state is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"collective group {self.group_name!r} is not initialized")
+        return state
+
+    def initialize(self, world_size: int, rank: int, master_addr: str, master_port: int | None):
+        if master_port is None:
+            raise ValueError("torch_nccl requires a TCPStore port")
+        if self.initialized:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"collective group {self.group_name!r} is already initialized")
+
+        tcp_store = torch.distributed.TCPStore(
+            master_addr,
+            master_port,
+            world_size,
+            rank == 0,
+            self.timeout,
+        )
+        store = torch.distributed.PrefixStore(self.group_name, tcp_store)
+        options = torch.distributed.ProcessGroupNCCL.Options()
+        options._timeout = self.timeout
+        process_group = torch.distributed.ProcessGroupNCCL(store, rank, world_size, options)
+        eager_connect = getattr(process_group, "eager_connect_single_device", None)
+        if eager_connect is not None:
+            eager_connect(torch.device("cuda", get_device_id()))
+
+        with self._groups_lock:
+            if self.group_name in self._groups:
+                process_group.abort()
+                raise RuntimeError(f"collective group {self.group_name!r} was initialized concurrently")
+            self._groups[self.group_name] = _TorchNCCLGroupState(store=store, process_group=process_group)
+
+    def _check_tensor(self, tensor):
+        if not isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+            raise TypeError(f"torch_nccl requires torch.Tensor, got {type(tensor)!r}")
+        if tensor.device.type == "cpu":
+            raise ValueError(f"torch_nccl requires an accelerator tensor, got device {tensor.device}")
+
+    def broadcast(self, tensor, src_rank: int = 0):
+        self._check_tensor(tensor)
+        options = torch.distributed.BroadcastOptions()
+        options.rootRank = src_rank
+        options.rootTensor = 0
+        self._state().process_group.broadcast([tensor], options).wait()
+
+    def barrier(self):
+        options = torch.distributed.BarrierOptions()
+        options.device_ids = [get_device_id()]
+        self._state().process_group.barrier(options).wait()
+
+    def destroy(self):
+        with self._groups_lock:
+            state = self._groups.pop(self.group_name, None)
+        if state is not None:
+            state.process_group.abort()
+
+
+def create_nccl_collective_group(
+    backend: str, group_name: str, backend_kwargs: dict | None = None
+) -> NCCLCollectiveGroup:
+    """Create a checkpoint collective without changing the Ray default path."""
+
+    backend_kwargs = dict(backend_kwargs or {})
+    if backend == "ray_nccl":
+        if backend_kwargs:
+            raise ValueError(f"ray_nccl does not accept backend kwargs: {sorted(backend_kwargs)}")
+        return RayNCCLCollectiveGroup(group_name)
+    if backend == "torch_nccl":
+        unknown = backend_kwargs.keys() - {"timeout_s"}
+        if unknown:
+            raise ValueError(f"torch_nccl received unsupported backend kwargs: {sorted(unknown)}")
+        return TorchNCCLCollectiveGroup(group_name, **backend_kwargs)
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported NCCL collective backend {backend!r}; expected 'ray_nccl' or 'torch_nccl'")
